days.title: Warsaw's Historic Heart
days.description: Explore Warsaw's iconic Old Town, royal palaces, and museums documenting the city's rich and turbulent history.

attractions.place: Warsaw Uprising Museum (Muzeum Powstania Warszawskiego), Warsaw

days.title: Warsaw's Cultural Treasures
days.description: Discover Warsaw's world-class museums, memorials, and palaces showcasing Polish art, science, and Jewish heritage.

attractions.place: National Museum in Warsaw (Muzeum Narodowe w Warszawie), Warsaw
Warsaw Ghetto Memorial (Pomnik Bohaterów Getta), Warsaw
Copernicus Science Centre (Centrum Nauki Kopernik), Warsaw

days.title: Journey to Kraków
days.description: Travel to Kraków and immerse yourself in the medieval charm of the Main Market Square, royal castle, and historic Kazimierz district.

attractions.place: Kraków Main Market Square (Rynek Główny), Kraków
Wawel Royal Castle (Zamek Królewski na Wawelu), Kraków

days.title: Auschwitz-Birkenau Memorial
days.description: Pay solemn respects at the Auschwitz-Birkenau Memorial and Museum, one of history's most important Holocaust sites.

days.title: Kraków's Jewish Heritage & Hidden Depths
days.description: Explore Kraków's profound Jewish history through Schindler's Factory, underground museums, and historic synagogues in the Kazimierz quarter.

attractions.place: Kraków Underground Museum (Muzeum Podziemia Rynku Głównego), Kraków
Remuh Synagogue and Cemetery (Synagoga Remuh), Kraków
